component.name: EX201 Studio
component.summary: Tune and understand your EX201 Bluetooth audio DSP

description.p: EX201 Studio gives you a clear view of the audio processing inside your EX201 board. Explore a filter, stage a change, and apply it when you are ready to listen.

ul.li: Edit all 19 supported DSP effects, including six ten-band parametric equalizers.
Use interactive curves and visual lessons for filters, dynamics, timing and gain.
Control master volume, mute and three board preset slots.
Export presets and recover previous sessions from automatic backups.
Explore a clearly labelled demo workspace without Bluetooth hardware.

description.p: The controller checks applied parameter blocks by reading them back from the board. The charts are teaching models rather than acoustic measurements. A supported EX201 Bluetooth control interface is required for hardware control. No vendor account is needed.
First native Flutter release, with a complete Dart controller, visual learning tools, verified parameter writes, preset files and recovery history.
